response.text: {"intro":"Fernwood Labs has 14 people in 5 teams and runs on 6 apps on Bike: Tools and budgets, Spend, Time off, Onboarding, Hiring and Customer contracts. Each one is a set of sheets, the steps a row moves through, and who can see and do what.","paragraphs":["Fernwood Labs has 14 people in 5 teams. Every app takes its people from the People list: the person who submits an expense, the employee who asks for leave, the owner of a tool or contract, and the manager of a new starter. Employees' managers decide on their leave requests, and no one is listed without a manager.","The company fills its roles through Hiring. Each opening has a hiring manager, a team and a salary band, and candidates move from Applied through Phone screen and Interview to Offer, then Hired or Rejected. Interviewers score each interview on a scale of 1 to 4. When an offer is above the top of the salary band, Wade approves or declines it. When a candidate is hired, the opening is marked Filled and a first-week plan is started in Onboarding with the candidate's name, start date and hiring manager.","Onboarding turns that plan into tasks. Aisha is asked to pick a buddy, Jon gets an IT task for the laptop, accounts and software seats, and the manager and the buddy each get a task due on the start date. On the start date the plan moves to First week. If the plan names a team tool, one seat on that tool is added for the new starter in Tools and budgets.","Tools and budgets lists each software tool with its owner, seats and annual cost, and holds the team budgets by quarter. Spend covers expenses and purchase requests, and both can be linked to a team budget. An expense needs a receipt before Lena is asked to approve it, and she is told again when it is ready to be paid with the next payroll. A purchase request over $2,000 goes to Krishna, and one for $2,000 or less goes to Lena. No one can approve or decline their own request.","Customer contracts holds 12 contracts with their annual value, start, renewal date and notice period. A contract over $50,000 a year needs legal review before it is signed, and Wade and Krishna are told when one is added. As the notice date comes near, the contract moves to Renewal due and its owner is asked to act. Later, Wade and the owner are told if it is still due.","Time off keeps leave requests, leave entries and balances. The yearly allowance is 25 days, and the company has 10 public holidays recorded. The employee's manager decides each request. An approved vacation takes its days off the balance, and a balance cannot go below zero. The request moves to Taken the day after its last day. Leave entries can only be added or reversed once, never changed or deleted.","Much of the work runs by itself. Tool renewals move to Renewal due 30 days ahead and email the owner. Receipts, approvals, buddy picks, scorecards and renewal reminders are sent to the right person as tasks or emails. Every change, made by hand or through Customize, is recorded in the Audit log."],"sentences":[{"capability":"Tools and budgets","sentence":"Holds the company's tools, the seats given to new starters and the team budgets; Wade and Lena manage them and tool owners look after their own tools."},{"capability":"Spend","sentence":"Holds expenses and purchase requests; everyone adds their own, Lena approves expenses and smaller requests, and Krishna approves requests over $2,000."},{"capability":"Time off","sentence":"Holds leave requests, leave entries and balances; employees ask for leave, managers decide, and Lena can see and add entries."},{"capability":"Onboarding","sentence":"Holds first-week plans and their tasks; Aisha and Wade manage the plans, and task owners such as Jon, managers and buddies do their tasks."},{"capability":"Hiring","sentence":"Holds openings, candidates and interviews; Wade manages everything, and Priya and Dev manage the candidates and interviews of their own openings."},{"capability":"Customer contracts","sentence":"Holds customer contracts and their renewals; Wade and Krishna manage all of them and owners look after their own."}],"phrases":[{"connection":"Onboarding > Tools and budgets","phrase":"when a first week starts, a seat is added on the team tool"},{"connection":"Hiring > Onboarding","phrase":"when someone is hired, their first week is planned"}],"worth":["18 expenses in Spend have no Category, which makes spending reports less reliable.","Onboarding has no plans yet, so the hire-to-first-week steps have not been used in practice.","Only Wade and Lena can see every tool, so tool owners see their own tools but no one else can see the full list."]}
